highlights.brief: MOABB v1.7.2修复pyRiemann兼容，提升EEG基准评测稳定性。
MOABB v1.7.1增强NEMAR下载失败时本地缓存可用性。
MOABB v1.7.0改善离线缓存访问与气泡图可复现性。

bullets_zh: 修复MOABB与pyRiemann均值API的兼容性。
在TRCA和TRCSP中使用gmean，以支持pyRiemann 0.12及当前0.13开发版。
通过关键字传递TRCSP度量，并增加TRCSP度量和TRCA协方差的回归覆盖。
bullets_en: Fixes MOABB compatibility with pyRiemann mean APIs.
Uses gmean in TRCA and TRCSP to support pyRiemann 0.12 and current 0.13 development versions.
Passes the TRCSP metric by keyword and adds regression coverage for TRCSP metrics and TRCA covariance.
items.brief: MOABB v1.7.2修复pyRiemann兼容，提升EEG基准评测稳定性。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.2 fixes pyRiemann compatibility for stable EEG benchmark evaluation.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.2 fixes compatibility with pyRiemann mean APIs. - Use `gmean` in TRCA and TRCSP, supporting pyRiemann 0.12 and current 0.13 development versions. - Pass the TRCSP metric by keyword to fix fitting with pyRiemann 0.12. - Add regression coverage for three TRCSP metrics and two TRCA covariance means. This patch release is based on v1.7.1 and includes the fix from [#1180](https://github.com/N

bullets_zh: 当NEMAR因代理或其他HTTP传输失败而不可达时，保持本地缓存的上游数据集数据可用。
在所有NEMAR下载边界捕获泄漏的httpx.TransportError异常。
保留默认auto提供者回退到数据集自身下载器。
bullets_en: Keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable through a proxy or another HTTP transport failure.
Catches leaked httpx.TransportError exceptions at all NEMAR download boundaries.
Preserves the default auto provider fallback to the dataset's own downloader.
items.brief: MOABB v1.7.1增强NEMAR下载失败时本地缓存可用性。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.1 keeps cached EEG benchmark data usable when NEMAR downloads fail.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.1 keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable through a proxy or another HTTP transport failure. - Catch leaked `httpx.TransportError` exceptions at all NEMAR download boundaries. - Preserve the default `auto` provider fallback to the dataset's own downloader. See [PR #1171](https://github.com/NeuroTechX/moabb/pull/1171).

bullets_zh: 修复MOABB 1.7.0中的离线缓存数据访问问题。
BaseDataset.get_data现在在NEMAR预取前使用完整处理缓存，使缓存在网络或NEMAR不可用时仍可用。
使dataset_bubble_plot布局可复现。
bullets_en: Fixes offline cached-data access in MOABB 1.7.0.
BaseDataset.get_data now uses a complete processing cache before NEMAR prefetch, so cached datasets remain usable when NEMAR or the network is unavailable.
Makes dataset_bubble_plot layouts reproducible.
items.brief: MOABB v1.7.0改善离线缓存访问与气泡图可复现性。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.0 improves offline cached-data access and reproducible dataset bubble plots.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.0 fixes offline cached-data access and makes dataset bubble plots reproducible. - `BaseDataset.get_data` now uses a complete processing cache before NEMAR prefetch, so cached datasets remain usable when NEMAR or the network is unavailable. - `dataset_bubble_plot` now has reproducible layouts by default and accepts `random_state` for controlled alternatives. Full changelog: https://moabb.

它提升了EEG/BCI评估工作流的可靠性与可复现性。

The patch prevents malformed experiment or configuration arguments during benchmark execution.
It improves reliability and reproducibility for EEG/BCI evaluation workflows.
